description: Open the spreadsheet at /home/ga/Documents/Spreadsheets/bread_experiments.xlsx. A baker needs to organize their sourdough bread experiment results. The header row is already created with columns: Experiment Name, Bread Flour (%), Whole Wheat (%), Rise Height (cm), Baking Time (min), Texture (1-5), Total Flour (g). Add data for 3 experiments: (1) Classic White: 100% bread flour, 0% whole wheat, 12cm rise, 45min bake, texture 5; (2) Rustic Blend: 70% bread flour, 30% whole wheat, 9cm rise, 50min bake, texture 4; (3) Hearty Wheat: 50% bread flour, 50% whole wheat, 7cm rise, 55min bake, texture 3. In the Total Flour (g) column, create a formula that calculates: (Bread Flour % + Whole Wheat %) * 5 for each row. Save the spreadsheet (Ctrl+S).
